title: Brain POST /api/trucks/{truck_id}/goal (request body)
description: Set a truck goal. {site}: a node id from the sim hello sites/junctions (fallback world.json sites), A* routed. {x, z}: when the hello carried roads the brain SNAPS the point to the nearest site/junction node (spec.md: 'brain snaps to a node when roads exist'); otherwise drives/plans to the exact point. Response 200: brain_state.schema.json#/$defs/BrainTruck. 404 unknown truck/site; 422 missing fields. DELETE /api/trucks/{truck_id}/goal (no body) clears goal, goal_site, route and returns BrainTruck. POST /api/trucks/{truck_id}/site/{site_id} is equivalent to {site}. The radio (this branch) only sends {x, z} waypoints; Unity MineGoals.GoalJson builds {x, z} too.
